<!-- proposition-1: body_md -->
\label{proposition:error_propagation}
Let $\bm{\mathrm{z}} \in \mathbb{R}_{+}^{n + m}$, $\hat{\bm{\mathrm{w}}} \in \mathbb{R}^{n + m}$, and $\bm{\mathrm{h}} \in \{ 0, 1 \}^{n + m}$.
For every $1 \leq l \leq n + m$,
\begin{equation*}
    |\bm{\mathrm{e}}_l^\intercal \bm{\mathrm{J}}_{\eta}(\bm{\mathrm{z}}) \mathrm{diag}( \bm{\mathrm{z}} ) \mathrm{diag}( \bm{\mathrm{h}} )| \hat{\bm{\mathrm{w}}} \leq \eta ( \bm{\mathrm{z}} )_l \Big[ \bm{\mathrm{h}}^\intercal \eta ( \bm{\mathrm{z}} ) + h_l \Big( 1 - 2 \eta ( \bm{\mathrm{z}} )_l \Big) \Big] \| \hat{\bm{\mathrm{w}}} \|_{\mathrm{\infty}}.
\end{equation*}
<!-- end proposition-1 -->
